comments.text: Side note: I recently came across this YouTube video which did a fantastic job showing just the basics of waveform collapse, without straying into silly metaphors and cartoons, or getting bogged down by historical narratives: [VIDEO] Highly recommended for anyone trying to grok the relationship between a wave, a particle, and an observation. In classical computing it might be analogous to breaking out of a for loop before it has run its intended course and then you're left with an incorrect (or incomplete) answer. [VIDEO]
